title: Bleeding Sweats
text: Bleeding Sweats. Bright red dye was not stable and bled into the laundry water, and permeated a white towel deliberately placed in laundry to see the dye amounts released.

product_metadata.title: Lifaith 100% Cotton Kitchen Everyday Basic Terry Pot Holder Heat Resistant Coaster Potholder for Cooking and Baking Set of 5 Red
features: Set includes 5 potholders measure 7 inch long by 7 inch wide.
Large size provides heat protection, high heat resistance allows you to remove dishes from the oven and hot pots from the stove.

100% terry looped cotton on one side and a heat resistant silverstone lining on the other. Quilting allows for easy flexibility in this potholder, offer durability and grip. Hanging loop for easy storage.
Ideal for hot pan holder, microwave splatter guard, spoon rest, jar opener, trivet, large coaster.
Easy to clean, durable, machine washable cold water dryer safe, tumble dry low.
description: These pot holders are the perfect accessory for your baking and cooking needs. This heavyweight institutional grade terry cloth potholder is made of 100-percent cotton and are machine washable. These holders measure 7 x 7 inches and feature a convenient loop for hooking storage.
